autoResume.label: Auto Resume
autoResume.description: Automatically resume the most recent session in the current directory

power.sleepPrevention.label: Sleep Prevention
power.sleepPrevention.description: Prevent the system sleeping during active sessions. Each level is cumulative — it adds the flags of all lower levels.

advisor.enabled.label: Enable Advisor
advisor.enabled.description: Pair a second model (assigned to the 'advisor' role) that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.

prewalk.enabled.label: Enable Prewalk
prewalk.enabled.description: Start on the active model, then switch to a fast/cheap model (default the 'smol' role) at the first edit/write after the plan nudge's todo list exists — the strong model plans, commits the todos, and starts the implementation before handing off. Overridable per session with --prewalk / --no-prewalk.

advisor.syncBacklog.label: Advisor Sync Backlog
advisor.syncBacklog.description: Pause the main agent for up to 30 seconds if the advisor falls behind by this many turns. Off disables catch-up delays.

advisor.immuneTurns.label: Advisor Immune Turns
advisor.immuneTurns.description: After an advisor concern or blocker interrupts, route further concerns/blockers non-interruptingly for this many primary turns.

git.enabled.label: Enable Git Integration
git.enabled.description: Show git branch, status, and PR information in the TUI and watch repository metadata.

providers.maxInFlightRequests.label: Max In-Flight Requests
providers.maxInFlightRequests.description: Maximum concurrent LLM requests per provider id (for example "openai" or "anthropic"), shared across local OMP processes with this config root. Omitted providers are unlimited.

providers.openai-codex.codeMode.label: Codex Code Mode
providers.openai-codex.codeMode.description: Route Codex code_mode_only models (GPT-5.6) through eval. The direct tools are eval, ask, todo, yield, think, checkpoint, and rewind. Use eval cells for other session tools. Mirrors codex-rs Code Mode. 'auto' follows the model catalog flag.

providers.openai-codex.codeModeDirectToo.label: Codex Code Mode Direct Tools
providers.openai-codex.codeModeDirectToo.description: Extra direct tools for Codex Code Mode. The standard direct tools are eval, ask, todo, yield, think, checkpoint, and rewind.

modelRoleStorage.label: Model Role Storage
modelRoleStorage.description: Where model selector role assignments are saved

theme.dark.label: Dark Theme
theme.dark.description: Theme used when the terminal has a dark background

theme.light.label: Light Theme
theme.light.description: Theme used when the terminal has a light background

symbolPreset.label: Symbol Preset
symbolPreset.description: Glyph set for icons and symbols (Unicode, Nerd Font, or ASCII)

colorBlindMode.label: Color-Blind Mode
colorBlindMode.description: Use blue instead of green for diff additions

composer.shape.label: Composer Shape
composer.shape.description: Visual layout of the input editor and status line

statusLine.contextLine.label: Context-Reactive Line
statusLine.contextLine.description: How the line between the left and right segments reflects context usage (box composer only)

statusLine.sessionAccent.label: Session Accent
statusLine.sessionAccent.description: Use the session name color for the editor border and status line gap

statusLine.transparent.label: Transparent Status Line
statusLine.transparent.description: Use the terminal's default background for the status line instead of the theme's `statusLineBg`. Powerline end caps are dropped because they need a contrasting fill to bridge into the surrounding terminal.

statusLine.compactThinkingLevel.label: Compact Thinking Level
statusLine.compactThinkingLevel.description: Show the thinking level as a single icon on the model name instead of a separate ` · <level>` suffix.

tools.artifactSpillThreshold.label: Artifact Spill Threshold (KB)
tools.artifactSpillThreshold.description: Tool output above this size is saved as an artifact; tail is kept inline

tools.artifactTailBytes.label: Artifact Tail Size (KB)
tools.artifactTailBytes.description: Amount of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

tools.artifactHeadBytes.label: Artifact Head Size (KB)
tools.artifactHeadBytes.description: Amount of head content kept inline alongside the tail when output spills to artifact (middle elision). 0 disables — keep tail only.

tools.outputMaxColumns.label: Output Column Cap
tools.outputMaxColumns.description: Per-line byte cap for streaming tool outputs (bash, python, js eval) and `read`. Lines wider than this are ellipsis-truncated; remaining bytes up to the next newline are dropped. 0 disables.

tools.artifactTailLines.label: Artifact Tail Lines
tools.artifactTailLines.description: Maximum lines of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact

statusLine.showHookStatus.label: Show Hook Status
statusLine.showHookStatus.description: Display hook status messages below the status line

terminal.showImages.label: Show Inline Images
terminal.showImages.description: Render images inline in the terminal

images.autoResize.label: Auto-Resize Images
images.autoResize.description: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility

images.blockImages.label: Block Images
images.blockImages.description: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers

images.describeForTextModels.label: Describe Images for Text Models
images.describeForTextModels.description: When an image is attached to a model without vision support, save it under local:// and inject a description from a vision-capable model instead of dropping it

images.urls.enabled.label: Serve Images as URLs
images.urls.enabled.description: Publish outgoing images through the configured backend chain and send URL-fetching providers short URLs instead of inline base64. Falls back to inline automatically when every backend or a provider fetch fails

images.urls.backends.label: Image URL Backends
images.urls.backends.description: Ordered destinations tried when publishing images for provider access

images.urls.command.label: Image Upload Command
images.urls.command.description: Argv template for the command backend; {file} is the image path, {mime}/{ext} optional. The last URL printed on stdout is used (e.g. pasta -b -f {file})

images.urls.publicBaseUrl.label: Image URL Public Base
images.urls.publicBaseUrl.description: Externally reachable base URL fronting the blob server (required for ssh, optional for direct)

images.urls.ttlHours.label: Image URL Lifetime (hours)
images.urls.ttlHours.description: Serving window for locally hosted image URLs, measured from the last time a conversation sent them; resuming a conversation re-arms the window at the same link. 0 keeps links alive while the broker runs

images.urls.bindHost.label: Image URL Bind Host
images.urls.bindHost.description: Host the blob server binds to; loopback for tunnels, 0.0.0.0 for direct serving

images.urls.sshTarget.label: Image URL SSH Target
images.urls.sshTarget.description: user@host destination for the ssh reverse forward

images.urls.sshRemotePort.label: Image URL SSH Remote Port
images.urls.sshRemotePort.description: Remote listen port of the ssh reverse forward that your web server proxies to

tui.resizeScrollback.label: Resize Scrollback
tui.resizeScrollback.description: How a settled terminal resize refreshes transcript rows retained in terminal scrollback

terminal.showProgress.label: Native Terminal Progress
terminal.showProgress.description: Emit OSC 9;4 indeterminate progress while the agent or context maintenance is running

tui.textSizing.label: Large Headings (Kitty)
tui.textSizing.description: Render Markdown H1 headings at 2x scale using Kitty's OSC 66 text-sizing protocol. Only takes effect on Kitty terminals; ignored everywhere else. Off by default.

tui.renderMermaid.label: Render Mermaid Diagrams
tui.renderMermaid.description: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as ASCII diagrams

tui.reactions.label: Agent Reactions
tui.reactions.description: Invite the agent to react to your message with an emoji badge on its bubble

tui.codexResetFireworks.label: Codex Reset Fireworks
tui.codexResetFireworks.description: Celebrate unscheduled Codex weekly usage resets and newly banked saved resets with a top-third fireworks overlay that remains until Escape

tui.titleState.label: Terminal Title Run State
tui.titleState.description: Show the agent run state in the terminal title's separator — an animated spinner while working (a static ':' on Windows), '>' when it's your turn, '!' when the agent is waiting on you

tui.hyperlinks.label: Terminal Hyperlinks
tui.hyperlinks.description: Wrap paths and URLs in OSC 8 hyperlinks for terminal-native click-to-open (auto: detect support; off: never; always: unconditional)

tui.tight.label: Tight Layout
tui.tight.description: Remove the 1-character horizontal padding from the left and right of the terminal output

display.smoothStreaming.label: Smooth Streaming
display.smoothStreaming.description: Reveal assistant text and streamed tool input smoothly while chunks arrive

display.hideToolActivity.label: Hide Tool Activity
display.hideToolActivity.description: Hide model-initiated tool calls and results from the transcript

display.showTokenUsage.label: Show Token Usage
display.showTokenUsage.description: Show per-turn token usage on assistant messages

display.showTurnTime.label: Show Turn Time
display.showTurnTime.description: Show the total prompt-to-yield time (including tool calls) on assistant message usage rows

display.cacheMissMarker.label: Cache Miss Marker
display.cacheMissMarker.description: Show a divider after an assistant turn whose request lost (missed) the prompt cache

display.collapseCompacted.label: Collapse Compacted History
display.collapseCompacted.description: Collapse pre-compaction history behind the summary divider on the live transcript; disable to keep the full transcript inline with dividers at each compaction point

showHardwareCursor.label: Show Hardware Cursor
showHardwareCursor.description: Show terminal cursor for IME support

tui.imeSafeCursor.label: IME-Safe Prompt Layout
tui.imeSafeCursor.description: Move the prompt's bottom border to a separate row so macOS IME preedit cannot displace it

hideThinkingBlock.label: Hide Thinking Blocks
hideThinkingBlock.description: Hide thinking blocks in assistant responses

proseOnlyThinking.label: Prose Only Thinking
proseOnlyThinking.description: Omit code blocks from thinking summaries and replace them with an ellipsis

omitThinking.label: Omit Thinking summaries
omitThinking.description: Instruct upstream providers to completely omit thinking summaries from responses (where supported)

externalThinking.label: External Thinking
externalThinking.description: Private scratchpad; not shown to user. Disables supported GPT, Claude, and Gemini reasoning

model.loopGuard.enabled.label: Loop Guard
model.loopGuard.enabled.description: Enable automatic stream loop detection for model reasoning and prose

model.loopGuard.checkAssistantContent.label: Loop Guard Scan Prose
model.loopGuard.checkAssistantContent.description: Apply loop guard to assistant prose messages in addition to thinking logs

model.loopGuard.toolCallReminder.label: Loop Guard Tool-Call Reminder
model.loopGuard.toolCallReminder.description: When a Gemini reasoning stream emits many consecutive planning headers without calling a tool, interrupt it and inject a reminder to issue a tool call (requires Loop Guard)

model.toolCallLoopGuard.enabled.label: Tool-Call Loop Guard
model.toolCallLoopGuard.enabled.description: Detect consecutive identical tool calls across turns and inject a corrective steer

model.toolCallLoopGuard.threshold.label: Tool-Call Loop Threshold
model.toolCallLoopGuard.threshold.description: Consecutive identical tool calls required before the corrective steer is injected

model.toolCallLoopGuard.exemptTools.label: Tool-Call Loop Exempt Tools
model.toolCallLoopGuard.exemptTools.description: Tool names that may repeat consecutively without triggering the cross-turn loop guard

inlineToolDescriptors.label: Inline Tool Descriptors
inlineToolDescriptors.description: Render full tool descriptors in the system prompt and strip top-level/nested descriptions from provider tool schemas so descriptor text is sent once. Auto enables this for Gemini models and disables it otherwise

includeModelInPrompt.label: Include Model in Prompt
includeModelInPrompt.description: Surface the active model identifier in the system prompt so the agent knows which model it is

includeWorkspaceTree.label: Include Workspace Tree
includeWorkspaceTree.description: Render the workspace directory tree in the system prompt. WARNING: This can bust prompt caching across sessions when files are modified.

skillful.label: List Skills in Prompt
skillful.description: List available skills in the system prompt; disable to save context and toggle per-session with /skillful

workspace.additionalDirectories.label: Additional Workspace Dirs
workspace.additionalDirectories.description: Extra workspace directories added to every session as additional roots (multi-root workspace). Managed live via /add-dir and /remove-dir. Paths resolve relative to cwd; absolute paths recommended. The agent is told these roots exist and can read/grep/glob them.

personality.label: Personality
personality.description: Communication style rendered into the system prompt's personality block

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative, -1 = provider default)

topK.label: Top K
topK.description: Sample from top-K tokens (-1 = provider default)

presencePenalty.label: Presence Penalty
presencePenalty.description: Penalty for introducing already-present tokens (-1 = provider default)

repetitionPenalty.label: Repetition Penalty
repetitionPenalty.description: Penalty for repeated tokens (-1 = provider default)

textVerbosity.label: Text Verbosity
textVerbosity.description: OpenAI Responses and Codex response verbosity (low, medium, or high)

tier.openai.label: Service Tier — OpenAI
tier.openai.description: Processing tier for OpenAI / OpenAI-Codex requests, and OpenAI-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as `service_tier`.

tier.anthropic.label: Service Tier — Anthropic
tier.anthropic.description: Processing tier for Claude requests. `priority` realizes fast mode (`speed: "fast"`) on supported direct Anthropic models; ignored on Bedrock/Vertex Claude and via OpenRouter.

tier.google.label: Service Tier — Google
tier.google.description: Processing tier for Gemini (Google AI Studio + Vertex) requests, and Google-family models routed via OpenRouter (none = omit). Sent as the top-level `serviceTier` field.

tier.subagent.label: Service Tier — Subagent
tier.subagent.description: Service Tier for spawned task/eval subagents. Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers (tracks /fast); pick a value to apply it to whichever family the subagent's model belongs to.

tier.advisor.label: Service Tier — Advisor
tier.advisor.description: Service Tier for the advisor model. None = standard processing; Inherit = match the main agent's live per-family tiers; pick a value to apply it to the advisor model's family.

retry.maxRetries.label: Retry Attempts
retry.maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts on API errors

retry.maxDelayMs.label: Max Retry Delay
retry.maxDelayMs.description: Maximum wait between retries, in ms. When the provider asks us to wait longer than this and no credential or model fallback succeeds, the request fails fast instead of sleeping (e.g. 3-hour Anthropic rate-limit windows). 0 disables the ceiling — to let the session auto-resume through provider-stated quota resets.

retry.modelFallback.label: Retry Model Fallback
retry.modelFallback.description: Allow retry recovery to switch to configured fallback models

retry.usageAwareFallback.label: Usage-Aware Fallback
retry.usageAwareFallback.description: Use reliable coding-plan quota reports to prefer same-provider accounts, then configured fallback models, before a hard usage limit. Ordinary configured API keys are excluded.

retry.usageReservePct.label: Reserve Margin
retry.usageReservePct.description: Treat a coding-plan model as near its limit below this remaining percentage. Unknown or unmapped usage keeps the primary model.

retry.usageReservePolicy.label: Reserve Policy
retry.usageReservePolicy.description: What to do when every same-provider coding-plan account is inside the reserve margin.

retry.fallbackChains.label: Retry Fallback Chains
retry.fallbackChains.description: JSON object mapping model roles, model selectors ("provider/model-id"), or provider wildcards ("provider/*") to ordered fallback selectors, e.g. {"default":["openai/gpt-4o-mini"],"google-antigravity/*":["google/*","google-vertex/*"]}. Model-oriented keys apply whenever that model/provider is active, regardless of role; a "provider/*" entry keeps the failing model's id and swaps the provider. An id-prefixed wildcard ("openrouter/google/*") re-prefixes the failing model's bare id (google-antigravity/gemini-x -> openrouter/google/gemini-x) and, used as a key, matches only that provider's ids under the prefix.

retry.fallbackRevertPolicy.label: Fallback Revert Policy
retry.fallbackRevertPolicy.description: When to return to the primary model after a fallback

providers.anthropic.serverSideFallback.label: Anthropic Server-Side Fallback (Fable 5)
providers.anthropic.serverSideFallback.description: When a Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 request is blocked by Anthropic's safety classifier, retry it on Claude Opus 4.8 server-side (Anthropic `server-side-fallback-2026-06-01` beta). Opt-in — leaving this off preserves the pre-fallback behavior for every request.

steeringMode.label: Steering Mode
steeringMode.description: How to process queued messages while agent is working

followUpMode.label: Follow-Up Mode
followUpMode.description: How to drain follow-up messages after a turn completes

interruptMode.label: Interrupt Mode
interruptMode.description: When steering messages interrupt tool execution

loop.mode.label: Loop Mode
loop.mode.description: What happens between /loop iterations before re-submitting the prompt

doubleEscapeAction.label: Double-Escape Action
doubleEscapeAction.description: What pressing Escape twice with an empty editor does: open the transcript rewind selector, open the session tree, or nothing

treeFilterMode.label: Session Tree Filter
treeFilterMode.description: Default filter mode when opening the session tree

autocompleteMaxVisible.label: Autocomplete Items
autocompleteMaxVisible.description: Max visible items in autocomplete dropdown (3-20)

spelling.typoDetection.label: Typo Detection (macOS)
spelling.typoDetection.description: Mark misspelled prompt words with the active macOS dictionaries

spelling.autocomplete.label: Word Autocomplete (macOS)
spelling.autocomplete.description: Show macOS dictionary word completions as inline hints accepted with Tab

spelling.autocorrect.label: Autocorrect (macOS)
spelling.autocorrect.description: Apply confident macOS spelling corrections after completed words

emojiAutocomplete.label: Emoji Autocomplete
emojiAutocomplete.description: Suggest emojis from `:name:` shortcodes and expand text emoticons like `:D` or `:-)`

paste.largeMenuThreshold.label: Large Paste Menu
paste.largeMenuThreshold.description: When a paste reaches this many lines, offer a menu to wrap it in a code block, wrap it in XML tags, or save it to a file. 0 disables the menu (large pastes still collapse to a [Paste] marker).

startup.quiet.label: Quiet Startup
startup.quiet.description: Skip welcome screen and startup status messages

startup.showSplash.label: Show Startup Splash
startup.showSplash.description: Show the full animated setup splash on normal interactive startup without rerunning setup. Quiet Startup still suppresses it.

startup.setupWizard.label: Setup Wizard
startup.setupWizard.description: Show newly added onboarding steps once per setup version

startup.checkUpdate.label: Check for Updates
startup.checkUpdate.description: Check for omp updates on startup

update.channel.label: Update Channel
update.channel.description: Update channel used by omp update and the startup update check

marketplace.autoUpdate.label: Marketplace Auto-Update
marketplace.autoUpdate.description: Check for plugin updates on startup

startup.changelogMode.label: Startup Changelog
startup.changelogMode.description: Choose whether update notes start as a summary, full details, or stay hidden

magicKeywords.enabled.label: Magic Keywords
magicKeywords.enabled.description: Enable hidden notices for standalone ultrathink, orchestrate, and workflowz keywords

magicKeywords.ultrathink.label: Ultrathink Keyword
magicKeywords.ultrathink.description: Let standalone ultrathink request maximum automatic thinking and append its hidden notice

magicKeywords.orchestrate.label: Orchestrate Keyword
magicKeywords.orchestrate.description: Let standalone orchestrate append its hidden multi-agent orchestration notice

magicKeywords.workflow.label: Workflow Keyword
magicKeywords.workflow.description: Let standalone workflowz append its hidden eval workflow notice

completion.notify.label: Completion Notification
completion.notify.description: Notify when the agent finishes a turn

error.notify.label: Error Notification
error.notify.description: Notify when the agent stops with an error

ask.timeout.label: Ask Timeout
ask.timeout.description: Auto-select the recommended ask option after this many seconds (0 disables)

ask.notify.label: Ask Notification
ask.notify.description: Notify when the ask tool is waiting for input

recap.enabled.label: Idle Recap
recap.enabled.description: Generate a brief LLM recap of where things stand after the terminal has been idle

recap.idleSeconds.label: Idle Recap Delay
recap.idleSeconds.description: Seconds to wait while idle before showing the recap

collab.webUrl.label: Web UI URL
collab.webUrl.description: Browser UI used by /collab links; empty derives from collab.relayUrl; explicit http:// is localhost-only

collab.displayName.label: Display Name
collab.displayName.description: Name shown to other collab participants (default: OS username)

share.serverUrl.label: Share Server
share.serverUrl.description: Share viewer/upload base used by /share (encrypted blob upload + viewer; links are <base>/<id>#<key>)

share.store.label: Share Store
share.store.description: Where /share uploads the encrypted session blob

share.redactSecrets.label: Share Secret Redaction
share.redactSecrets.description: Run the secret obfuscator over /share snapshots before upload (uses the secrets.* config)

stt.modelName.label: Speech Model
stt.modelName.description: Local on-device speech model. Parakeet TDT v3 (sherpa-onnx) is the SoTA default; Whisper base/small/large-v3-turbo tiers (transformers.js) trade size for multilingual coverage. Downloaded on first use.

stt.submitTrigger.label: Speech-to-Text Submit Trigger
stt.submitTrigger.description: Choose when speech dictation automatically submits: Never, Release (2+ words), Release with complete sentence, or When I Say Submit.

contextPromotion.enabled.label: Auto-Promote Context
contextPromotion.enabled.description: Promote to a larger-context model on context overflow instead of compacting

extendedContext.label: Extended Context
extendedContext.description: Use premium long-context windows on models that bill extra past a threshold (e.g. GPT-5.6 1M charges 2x input above 272K); off caps them at the standard-pricing window

compaction.enabled.label: Auto-Compact
compaction.enabled.description: Automatically compact context when it gets too large

compaction.midTurnEnabled.label: Mid-Turn Compaction
compaction.midTurnEnabled.description: Check thresholds at safe mid-turn tool-loop boundaries before the next provider request

compaction.methodOrder.label: Compaction Method Order
compaction.methodOrder.description: Preferred fallback order for automatic context maintenance; unavailable or failed methods advance to the next choice

compaction.thresholdPercent.label: Compaction Threshold
compaction.thresholdPercent.description: Percent threshold for context maintenance; set to Default to use legacy reserve-based behavior

compaction.thresholdTokens.label: Compaction Token Limit
compaction.thresholdTokens.description: Fixed token limit for context maintenance; overrides percentage if set

compaction.handoffSaveToDisk.label: Save Handoff Docs
compaction.handoffSaveToDisk.description: Save generated handoff documents to markdown files for the auto-handoff flow

compaction.remoteStreamingV2Enabled.label: Remote Compaction V2
compaction.remoteStreamingV2Enabled.description: Use Responses streaming compaction for compatible remote compaction models

compaction.asyncEnabled.label: Async Compaction
compaction.asyncEnabled.description: Speculatively summarize in the background as context nears the compaction threshold, then splice the ready result in when the threshold is crossed

compaction.idleEnabled.label: Idle Compaction
compaction.idleEnabled.description: Compact context while idle when token count exceeds threshold

compaction.idleThresholdTokens.label: Idle Compaction Threshold
compaction.idleThresholdTokens.description: Token count above which idle compaction triggers

compaction.idleTimeoutSeconds.label: Idle Compaction Delay
compaction.idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait while idle before compacting

compaction.supersedeReads.label: Supersede Stale Reads
compaction.supersedeReads.description: Prune older read results when the same file is read again (cache-aware, runs every turn)

compaction.dropUseless.label: Elide Uneventful Results
compaction.dropUseless.description: Prune tool results flagged contextually useless (no matches, timed-out waits) once consumed (cache-aware)

snapcompact.systemPrompt.label: Snapcompact System Prompt
snapcompact.systemPrompt.description: Experimental: render selected system prompt text as dense PNG image(s) and attach to the first user message (vision models only). Saves tokens; loses prompt caching for imaged text.

snapcompact.toolResults.label: Snapcompact Tool Results
snapcompact.toolResults.description: Experimental: render large historical tool results as dense PNG image(s) instead of text (vision models only). Saves tokens on accumulated read/search output.

tools.format.label: Tool Calling Mode
tools.format.description: Controls how tools are exposed to the model. Auto uses provider-native tool calls unless the selected model is marked as not supporting them, then falls back to the GLM owned dialect. Native forces provider-native tools; the other values force the named owned dialect. Applies on session start.

snapcompact.shape.label: Snapcompact Shape
snapcompact.shape.description: Frame shape snapcompact prints text with (compaction archive and inline imaging). Auto picks a shape tuned for the current model.

branchSummary.enabled.label: Branch Summaries
branchSummary.enabled.description: Prompt to summarize when leaving a branch

memory.backend.label: Memory Backend
memory.backend.description: Off, local summary pipeline, Mnemopi SQLite, Hindsight remote memory, or Sharpshooter

sharpshooter.model.label: Sharpshooter Model
sharpshooter.model.description: Model selector for extraction/consolidation, empty = smol role

autolearn.enabled.label: Auto-Learn (experimental)
autolearn.enabled.description: After the agent stops, nudge it to capture lessons to memory and create/enhance isolated managed skills

autolearn.autoContinue.label: Auto-run capture at stop
autolearn.autoContinue.description: When on, auto-run one private capture turn at stop (uses extra tokens). When off, only standing auto-learn guidance remains.

mnemopi.dbPath.label: Mnemopi DB Path
mnemopi.dbPath.description: Optional SQLite DB path. Defaults to the agent memories directory.

mnemopi.bank.label: Mnemopi Bank
mnemopi.bank.description: Optional shared bank base name. Per-project modes derive project-local banks from it.

mnemopi.scoping.label: Mnemopi Scoping
mnemopi.scoping.description: global = one shared bank; per-project = isolated bank per cwd; per-project-tagged = project-local writes plus global recall visibility

mnemopi.embeddingVariant.label: Embedding variant
mnemopi.embeddingVariant.description: Local embedding model family. en = stronger English model; multilingual = cross-language model. Changing this rebuilds existing memory embeddings on next start.

mnemopi.autoRecall.label: Mnemopi Auto Recall
mnemopi.autoRecall.description: Recall local memories into the first turn of each session

mnemopi.autoRetain.label: Mnemopi Auto Retain
mnemopi.autoRetain.description: Retain completed conversation turns into local Mnemopi memory

mnemopi.polyphonicRecall.label: Mnemopi Polyphonic Recall
mnemopi.polyphonicRecall.description: Enable 4-voice recall (vector, graph, fact, temporal) fused with reciprocal rank fusion

mnemopi.enhancedRecall.label: Mnemopi Enhanced Recall
mnemopi.enhancedRecall.description: Enable the tiered query result cache for repeated and similar recall queries

mnemopi.proactiveLinking.label: Mnemopi Proactive Linking
mnemopi.proactiveLinking.description: Ingest new memories into the episodic graph as they are stored, linking them to related entities and memories

mnemopi.noEmbeddings.label: Mnemopi Disable Embeddings
mnemopi.noEmbeddings.description: Force deterministic FTS-only recall instead of vector embeddings

mnemopi.embeddingModel.label: Mnemopi Embedding Model
mnemopi.embeddingModel.description: Advanced: explicit embedding model id that overrides the variant. Leave empty to use mnemopi.embeddingVariant.

mnemopi.embeddingApiUrl.label: Mnemopi Embedding API URL
mnemopi.embeddingApiUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint passed to Mnemopi

mnemopi.embeddingApiKey.label: Mnemopi Embedding API Key
mnemopi.embeddingApiKey.description: Optional embedding API key passed to Mnemopi

mnemopi.llmMode.label: Mnemopi LLM Mode
mnemopi.llmMode.description: Use no LLM, the online tiny model (the TINY role from /models, else @smol), or a remote OpenAI-compatible endpoint

mnemopi.llmBaseUrl.label: Mnemopi LLM Base URL
mnemopi.llmBaseUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint for Mnemopi remote mode

mnemopi.llmApiKey.label: Mnemopi LLM API Key
mnemopi.llmApiKey.description: Optional LLM API key for Mnemopi remote mode

mnemopi.llmModel.label: Mnemopi LLM Model
mnemopi.llmModel.description: Optional LLM model name for Mnemopi remote mode

hindsight.apiToken.label: Hindsight API Token
hindsight.apiToken.description: Bearer token for authenticated Hindsight servers

hindsight.scoping.label: Hindsight Scoping
hindsight.scoping.description: global = one shared bank; per-project = isolated bank per cwd; per-project-tagged = shared bank with project tags so global + project memories merge on recall

hindsight.autoRecall.label: Hindsight Auto Recall
hindsight.autoRecall.description: Recall memories on the first turn of each session

hindsight.autoRetain.label: Hindsight Auto Retain
hindsight.autoRetain.description: Retain transcript every N turns and at session boundaries

hindsight.retainMode.label: Hindsight Retain Mode
hindsight.retainMode.description: full-session = upsert one document per session, last-turn = chunked

hindsight.mentalModelsEnabled.label: Hindsight Mental Models
hindsight.mentalModelsEnabled.description: Read curated reflect summaries (mental models) into developer instructions at boot. Loads existing models on the bank — does not write. Pair with hindsight.mentalModelAutoSeed to also auto-create the built-in seed set.

hindsight.mentalModelAutoSeed.label: Hindsight Mental Model Auto-Seed
hindsight.mentalModelAutoSeed.description: At session start, create any built-in mental models (project-conventions, project-decisions, user-preferences) that do not yet exist on the bank.

ttsr.enabled.label: TTSR
ttsr.enabled.description: Interrupt the agent mid-stream when output matches rule patterns (Time-Traveling Stream Rules)

ttsr.contextMode.label: TTSR Context Mode
ttsr.contextMode.description: What to do with partial output when TTSR triggers

ttsr.interruptMode.label: TTSR Interrupt Mode
ttsr.interruptMode.description: When to interrupt mid-stream vs inject warning after completion

ttsr.repeatMode.label: TTSR Repeat Mode
ttsr.repeatMode.description: How rules can repeat: once per session or after a message gap

ttsr.repeatGap.label: TTSR Repeat Gap
ttsr.repeatGap.description: Messages before a rule can trigger again

ttsr.builtinRules.label: Built-in Rules
ttsr.builtinRules.description: Load the default rules shipped with the agent (override individually with ttsr.disabledRules)

ttsr.disabledRules.label: Disabled Rules
ttsr.disabledRules.description: Rule names to ignore entirely (applies to bundled defaults and your own rules)

edit.mode.label: Edit Mode
edit.mode.description: Select the edit tool variant (replace, patch, hashline, or apply_patch)

edit.fuzzyMatch.label: Fuzzy Match
edit.fuzzyMatch.description: Accept high-confidence fuzzy matches for whitespace differences

edit.fuzzyThreshold.label: Fuzzy Match Threshold
edit.fuzzyThreshold.description: Similarity threshold (0-1) for accepting fuzzy matches

edit.streamingAbort.label: Abort on Failed Preview
edit.streamingAbort.description: Abort streaming edit tool calls when patch preview fails

edit.recoverInlineEdits.label: Recover Inline Edit Payloads
edit.recoverInlineEdits.description: Execute edit payloads the model emits as plain text by converting them into edit tool calls

edit.blockAutoGenerated.label: Block Auto-Generated Files
edit.blockAutoGenerated.description: Prevent editing of files that appear to be auto-generated (protoc, sqlc, swagger, etc.)

edit.enforceSeenLines.label: Enforce Seen-Line Guard
edit.enforceSeenLines.description: Reject edits anchored on lines a prior read/search never displayed in full

edit.blackbox.enabled.label: Record Parse Regressions
edit.blackbox.enabled.description: Append full before/after source when an edit introduces an AST parse failure

edit.autoRepair.enabled.label: Auto-Repair Parse Regressions
edit.autoRepair.enabled.description: When an edit breaks a file's AST parse, ask the smol model to fix the broken region (validated by re-parse; falls back to a warning)

readLineNumbers.label: Line Numbers
readLineNumbers.description: Prepend line numbers to read tool output by default

read.defaultLimit.label: Default Read Limit
read.defaultLimit.description: Default number of lines returned when agent calls read without a limit

read.renderMarkdown.label: Markdown Previews
read.renderMarkdown.description: Render Markdown read results as formatted terminal Markdown previews instead of raw source

read.summarize.enabled.label: Read Summaries
read.summarize.enabled.description: Return structural code summaries when read is called without an explicit selector

read.summarize.prose.label: Prose Summaries
read.summarize.prose.description: Return structural summaries for Markdown and plain text reads

read.summarize.minBodyLines.label: Read Summary Body Lines
read.summarize.minBodyLines.description: Minimum multiline body or literal length before read summaries collapse it

read.summarize.minCommentLines.label: Read Summary Comment Lines
read.summarize.minCommentLines.description: Minimum multiline block comment length before read summaries collapse it

read.summarize.minTotalLines.label: Read Summary Minimum File Length
read.summarize.minTotalLines.description: Files with fewer total lines are read verbatim instead of structurally summarized

read.summarize.unfoldUntil.label: Read Summary Unfold Target
read.summarize.unfoldUntil.description: BFS-unfold elidable spans until the summary is at least this many visible lines. 0 keeps only the outermost elisions.

read.summarize.unfoldLimit.label: Read Summary Unfold Ceiling
read.summarize.unfoldLimit.description: Hard ceiling on summary size while BFS-unfolding. An unfold whose revealed lines would exceed this is skipped (that span stays folded) and unfolding continues with the remaining spans.

read.toolResultPreview.label: Inline Read Previews
read.toolResultPreview.description: Render read tool results inline in the transcript instead of summary rows

lsp.enabled.label: LSP
lsp.enabled.description: Enable the lsp tool for code intelligence (definitions, references, diagnostics, rename)

lsp.lazy.label: Lazy LSP Startup
lsp.lazy.description: Start language servers on first use (lsp tool or editing a matching file type) instead of at session startup

lsp.shared.label: Shared Language Servers
lsp.shared.description: Share one language server per project across omp instances via the daemon broker (falls back to private servers when unavailable)

lsp.formatOnWrite.label: Format on Write
lsp.formatOnWrite.description: Automatically format code files using LSP after writing

lsp.diagnosticsOnWrite.label: Diagnostics on Write
lsp.diagnosticsOnWrite.description: Return LSP diagnostics after writing code files

lsp.diagnosticsOnEdit.label: Diagnostics on Edit
lsp.diagnosticsOnEdit.description: Return LSP diagnostics after editing code files

lsp.diagnosticsDeduplicate.label: Deduplicate Diagnostics
lsp.diagnosticsDeduplicate.description: Suppress post-edit LSP diagnostics already shown for a file; only surface new or changed ones

bash.enabled.label: Bash
bash.enabled.description: Enable the bash tool for shell command execution

bash.autoBackground.enabled.label: Bash Auto-Background
bash.autoBackground.enabled.description: Automatically background long-running bash commands and deliver the result later

bash.patterns.label: Bash Approval Patterns
bash.patterns.description: Ordered bash command approval rules. Each item has match and approval fields; only '*' wildcards are supported.

bashInterceptor.enabled.label: Bash Interceptor
bashInterceptor.enabled.description: Block shell commands that have dedicated tools

bash.direnv.label: direnv Auto-Load
bash.direnv.description: Auto-load a repo's direnv/devenv `.envrc` into the bash session so devenv tools and env vars are present without manual `direnv exec`. Honors direnv's allow list: an `.envrc` you haven't `direnv allow`ed is never executed

bash.direnvLoadTimeoutMs.label: direnv Load Timeout (ms)
bash.direnvLoadTimeoutMs.description: Max wait for the first `direnv export` (a cold devenv shell can be slow); on timeout the session runs without the direnv env

shellMinimizer.enabled.label: Shell Minimizer
shellMinimizer.enabled.description: Compress verbose shell output (git, npm, cargo, etc.) before returning it to the agent

shellMinimizer.sourceOutlineLevel.label: Shell Minimizer Source Outline
shellMinimizer.sourceOutlineLevel.description: Source outline mode for cat/read of source files: default or aggressive

eval.py.label: Python Eval Backend
eval.py.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch Python cells to the IPython kernel

eval.js.label: JavaScript Eval Backend
eval.js.description: Allow the eval tool to dispatch JavaScript cells to the in-process runtime

eval.tools.enabled.label: Eval-Defined Tools
eval.tools.enabled.description: Let eval cells define tools (@tool in Python, tool(fn) in JS) that task, agent(), and workpool() subagents can call

eval.workpool.freshAgents.label: Fresh Workpool Agents
eval.workpool.freshAgents.description: Spawn a new subagent for every workpool item instead of reusing workers or batching queued items

eval.autoBackground.enabled.label: Eval Auto-Background
eval.autoBackground.enabled.description: Automatically background long-running eval cells and deliver the result later

python.kernelMode.label: Python Kernel Mode
python.kernelMode.description: Keep the IPython kernel alive across eval calls or start fresh each time

python.interpreter.label: Python Interpreter
python.interpreter.description: Optional path to an exact Python executable. When set, automatic Python runtime discovery is skipped.

tools.approval.label: Tool Approval Policies
tools.approval.description: Per-tool approval policies. Set to 'allow' to auto-approve, 'prompt' to require confirmation, or 'deny' to block. Overrides are honored in every approval mode.

tools.approvalMode.label: Tool Approval
tools.approvalMode.description: Default approval behavior for tool calls. 'Always ask' auto-approves read-only tools only. 'Write' auto-approves read and workspace-write tools. 'Yolo' auto-approves all tiers; user policy may still prompt or block.

todo.enabled.label: Todos
todo.enabled.description: Enable the todo tool for task tracking

todo.reminders.label: Todo Reminders
todo.reminders.description: Remind the agent to complete todos before stopping

todo.remindersMax.label: Todo Reminder Limit
todo.remindersMax.description: Maximum number of todo reminders before giving up

todo.eager.label: Create Todos Automatically
todo.eager.description: How strongly to push automatic todo-list creation after the first message

glob.enabled.label: Glob
glob.enabled.description: Enable the glob tool for glob-based file lookup

grep.enabled.label: Grep
grep.enabled.description: Enable the grep tool for regex content search

grep.contextBefore.label: Grep Context Before
grep.contextBefore.description: Lines of context before each grep match

grep.contextAfter.label: Grep Context After
grep.contextAfter.description: Lines of context after each grep match

astGrep.enabled.label: AST Grep
astGrep.enabled.description: Enable the ast_grep tool for structural AST search

astEdit.enabled.label: AST Edit
astEdit.enabled.description: Enable the ast_edit tool for structural AST rewrites

debug.enabled.label: Debug
debug.enabled.description: Enable the debug tool for DAP-based debugging

launch.enabled.label: Launch
launch.enabled.description: Enable the launch tool for supervising shared long-running project processes

speechgen.enabled.label: Speech Generation
speechgen.enabled.description: Enable the tts tool for on-device (Kokoro) or xAI Grok Voice speech-file synthesis

generate_image.enabled.label: Generate Image
generate_image.enabled.description: Enable the generate_image tool (text-to-image generation and editing). Exposed as an xd:// device when tools.xdev is on.

computer.enabled.label: Computer
computer.enabled.description: Enable the scriptable host-desktop eval prelude (screenshots, input, accessibility)

computer.display.label: Computer Display
computer.display.description: Composite all displays or select a native display id

computer.maxWidth.label: Computer Screenshot Width
computer.maxWidth.description: Maximum composite screenshot width in pixels

computer.maxHeight.label: Computer Screenshot Height
computer.maxHeight.description: Maximum composite screenshot height in pixels

images.questionTimeoutMs.label: Image Question Timeout
images.questionTimeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout for the vision-model call behind read's ?q= image questions, in milliseconds. A stalled provider fails fast with a timeout error instead of blocking until manual abort. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

checkpoint.enabled.label: Checkpoint/Rewind
checkpoint.enabled.description: Enable the checkpoint and rewind tools for context checkpointing

fetch.enabled.label: Read URLs
fetch.enabled.description: Allow the read tool to fetch and process URLs

vault.enabled.label: Obsidian Vault
vault.enabled.description: Enable the vault:// internal URL for reading and editing Obsidian vault content via the Obsidian CLI. When disabled, vault:// resolution is refused and the vault:// entry is omitted from the system prompt.

github.enabled.label: GitHub CLI
github.enabled.description: Enable the github tool (op-based dispatch for repository, issue, pull request, diff, search, checkout, push, and Actions watch workflows)

github.cache.enabled.label: GitHub View Cache
github.cache.enabled.description: Cache rendered issue/PR view output in ~/.omp/cache/github-cache.db so repeated reads are free

github.cache.softTtlSec.label: GitHub Cache Soft TTL
github.cache.softTtlSec.description: Within this window, cached issue/PR view rows are returned directly (seconds; default 5 minutes)

github.cache.hardTtlSec.label: GitHub Cache Hard TTL
github.cache.hardTtlSec.description: Past the soft TTL the cached row is returned and refreshed in the background; past the hard TTL it is dropped (seconds; default 7 days)

web_search.enabled.label: Web Search
web_search.enabled.description: Enable the web_search tool for live web results

security.enabled.label: Security
security.enabled.description: Enable OMP-native security scan planning, execution, and the read-only security:// resource namespace

ask.enabled.label: Ask
ask.enabled.description: Enable the ask tool for interactive user questions

browser.enabled.label: Browser
browser.enabled.description: Enable the browser eval prelude for scripted Chromium automation (Puppeteer)

browser.cdpUrl.label: Browser CDP URL
browser.cdpUrl.description: Default HTTP CDP discovery endpoint (for example http://127.0.0.1:9222) to attach to instead of launching a browser. Explicit app.cdp_url or app.path on the tool call take precedence.

browser.relay.label: Browser Relay
browser.relay.description: Drive your own Chrome tabs through the omp browser relay. Install the extension once (`omp browser-relay install`); the relay server auto-starts when the browser prelude needs it. Takes precedence over Browser CDP URL; set PI_BROWSER_RELAY=0 or PI_BROWSER_RELAY=1 to override.

browser.headless.label: Headless Browser
browser.headless.description: Launch browser in headless mode (disable to show browser UI)

browser.cmux.label: cmux Browser
browser.cmux.description: Use cmux WKWebView surfaces for browser automation when a cmux socket is available. Set PI_BROWSER_CMUX=0 or PI_BROWSER_CMUX=1 to override.

browser.screenshotDir.label: Screenshot Directory
browser.screenshotDir.description: Directory to save screenshots. If unset, screenshots go to a temp file. Supports ~. Examples: ~/Downloads, ~/Desktop, /sdcard/Download (Android)

tools.intentTracing.label: Intent Tracing
tools.intentTracing.description: Ask the agent to describe the intent of each tool call before executing it

tools.abortOnFabricatedResult.label: Abort On Fabricated Tool Result
tools.abortOnFabricatedResult.description: With in-band tool calls, stop the model immediately when it starts hallucinating a tool result mid-turn. Disable to let the model finish generating and discard the fabricated continuation instead.

tools.maxTimeout.label: Max Tool Timeout
tools.maxTimeout.description: Maximum timeout in seconds the agent can set for any tool (0 = no limit)

async.enabled.label: Async Execution
async.enabled.description: Enable async bash commands and background task execution

async.pollWaitDuration.label: Max Poll Time
async.pollWaitDuration.description: How long a `hub` wait watches background jobs before returning the current state. A fixed value waits that exact duration every time. `smart` adapts: it starts at 5s and lengthens with each back-to-back wait (up to 5m), then resets to 5s after about a minute without waiting.

irc.timeoutMs.label: IRC Timeout
irc.timeoutMs.description: Default timeout for hub message waits (and send await:true) in milliseconds; 0 disables the timeout

tools.xdev.label: xd:// Tools
tools.xdev.description: Mount rarely-used (discoverable) tools under xd:// device URLs driven via read/write instead of shipping their schemas on every request. Sessions whose explicit tool list grants read but omits write mount devices through a device-only write transport (filesystem writes stay rejected). Disable to expose every enabled tool top-level.

tools.xdevDocs.label: xd:// Prompt Docs
tools.xdevDocs.description: Choose which mounted-device docs and schemas are inlined in the system prompt. Built-ins keeps core tools inline while MCP and extension tools stay on-demand.

tools.xdevInlineDevices.label: xd:// Inline Devices
tools.xdevInlineDevices.description: When xd:// Prompt Docs is Built-ins Only, inline dynamic devices whose names match these glob patterns (for example mcp__context_mode_*). Catalog Only ignores this setting.

mcp.renderMarkdownResults.label: MCP Markdown Results
mcp.renderMarkdownResults.description: Render non-JSON MCP text results as Markdown in the transcript

mcp.notifications.label: MCP Update Injection
mcp.notifications.description: Inject MCP resource updates into the agent conversation

mcp.notificationDebounceMs.label: MCP Notification Debounce
mcp.notificationDebounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds for MCP resource updates before injecting them into the conversation

plan.enabled.label: Plan Mode
plan.enabled.description: Enable plan mode for read-only exploration and planning before execution

plan.defaultOnStartup.label: Start in Plan Mode
plan.defaultOnStartup.description: Automatically enter plan mode at the start of every new session

goal.enabled.label: Goal Mode
goal.enabled.description: Enable per-session goal mode and the hidden goal tool

goal.statusInFooter.label: Goal Status in Footer
goal.statusInFooter.description: Show token budget alongside the goal indicator in the status line

goal.continuationModes.label: Goal Continuation Modes
goal.continuationModes.description: Run modes where active goals may auto-continue between turns

title.refreshOnReplan.label: Refresh Title on Replan
title.refreshOnReplan.description: Refresh generated session titles after todo init replans unless the title was set by the user

task.isolation.enabled.label: Isolate Subagents
task.isolation.enabled.description: Run subagents in an isolated copy of the checkout and integrate their changes afterwards

isolation.backend.label: Isolation Backend
isolation.backend.description: Backend used for subagent isolation and worktree cloning

worktree.clone.label: Clone Checkout into Worktrees
worktree.clone.description: New worktrees from `github pr_checkout` and `git worktree add` in bash start as a copy-on-write clone of the current checkout so ignored build artifacts (node_modules, target) carry over; falls back to a plain checkout when the filesystem cannot clone

worktree.cleanSource.label: Clean Source Checkout on /wt
worktree.cleanSource.description: When creating a worktree with `/wt`, reset tracked changes and remove untracked files from the original checkout after carrying them over

task.isolation.apply.label: Apply Isolated Changes
task.isolation.apply.description: Automatically apply successful isolated task changes to the parent checkout; disable to retain patch or branch artifacts

task.isolation.merge.label: Isolation Merge Strategy
task.isolation.merge.description: How isolated task changes are integrated (patch apply or branch merge)

task.isolation.commits.label: Isolation Commit Style
task.isolation.commits.description: Commit message style for nested repo changes (generic or AI-generated)

worktree.base.label: Worktree Base Directory
worktree.base.description: Base directory for agent-managed worktrees — task-isolation copies, `github` PR checkouts, and `omp worktree` cleanup all live here. Unset uses ~/.omp/wt. Must be an absolute or ~-relative path; relative paths are ignored. The OMP_WORKTREE_DIR env var overrides this.

task.eager.label: Prefer Task Delegation
task.eager.description: How strongly to push delegating work to subagents

task.batch.label: Batch Task Calls
task.batch.description: Switch the task tool to its batch shape: one call carries { context, tasks[] } — one subagent per item, with an optional per-item agent (defaulting to the session spawn-policy agent), per-item isolation, and a required shared context prepended to every assignment. With async.enabled=true, each spawn runs as an independent background agent with the normal idle/parked lifecycle; otherwise the call blocks for merged results. Disable to restore the flat single-spawn schema.

task.enableEffort.label: Per-Task Effort
task.enableEffort.description: Expose the optional effort parameter on task spawns, allowing callers to override each subagent's thinking level

task.maxConcurrency.label: Max Concurrent Tasks
task.maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of subagents running concurrently

task.enableLsp.label: LSP in Subagents
task.enableLsp.description: Allow subagents spawned via the task tool to use the lsp tool. Off by default to keep subagents cheap; enable when LSP-aware delegation is worth the extra tokens.

task.maxRecursionDepth.label: Max Task Recursion
task.maxRecursionDepth.description: How many levels deep subagents can spawn their own subagents

task.maxRuntimeMs.label: Max Subagent Runtime
task.maxRuntimeMs.description: Hard wall-clock limit per subagent (ms). 0 disables it. Defense-in-depth against provider-side stream hangs that escape the inference-layer watchdog; triggers a normal subagent abort with a 'timed out' reason.

task.agentIdleTtlMs.label: Agent Idle TTL
task.agentIdleTtlMs.description: How long an idle subagent stays live in memory before being parked to disk (ms). Parked agents are revived automatically when messaged or resumed. 0 keeps idle agents live until exit.

task.softRequestBudget.label: Soft Subagent Request Budget
task.softRequestBudget.description: Soft per-subagent request budget (assistant requests per run). Crossing it injects a wrap-up steering notice (see task.softRequestBudgetNotice); at 1.5x the budget the run is force-stopped and the agent must yield its partial findings. 0 disables the guard. Bundled scout/sonic agents cap out at a lower built-in budget, so a value below that cap still applies to them.

task.softRequestBudgetNotice.label: Soft Request Budget Notice
task.softRequestBudgetNotice.description: Inject one steering notice when a subagent crosses its soft request budget, asking it to wrap up before the 1.5x forced-yield stop.

task.maxEffort.label: Maximum Per-Spawn Effort
task.maxEffort.description: Maximum reasoning effort allowed for the task tool's per-spawn effort hint. Lower values prevent callers from escalating subagents above this ceiling; the default preserves the model's full range.

task.prewalk.label: Generic Task Prewalk
task.prewalk.description: Arm prewalk for the bundled generic `task` subagent: it starts on its resolved model, plans and begins the implementation, then hands off to the 'smol' role at its first edit/write. Per-agent overrides (task.agentPrewalk, configured from the /agents hub) and user agent `prewalk` frontmatter apply regardless of this toggle.

tasks.todoClearDelay.label: Todo Auto-Clear Delay
tasks.todoClearDelay.description: Delay before completed or abandoned todos are removed from the todo widget

task.showResolvedModelBadge.label: Show Resolved Model Badge
task.showResolvedModelBadge.description: Display the actual model ID used by each subagent in the task widget status line

secrets.enabled.label: Hide Secrets
secrets.enabled.description: Obfuscate configured secrets and redact credential-shaped tokens before sending to AI providers

providers.ollama-cloud.maxConcurrency.label: Ollama Cloud Max Concurrency
providers.ollama-cloud.maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent Ollama Cloud subagent runs per process; 0 disables the provider-specific limit

providers.webSearchOrder.label: Web Search Provider Order
providers.webSearchOrder.description: Prioritized providers for the web_search tool; unlisted providers retain their default order afterward

providers.webSearchExclude.label: Excluded Web Search Providers
providers.webSearchExclude.description: Providers that web_search should never use, even as fallbacks

providers.webSearchTimeoutSeconds.label: Web Search Timeout
providers.webSearchTimeoutSeconds.description: Hard timeout for each provider's search transport before web_search advances to the next fallback, in seconds (maximum 300)

providers.webSearchGeminiModel.label: Gemini web_search model
providers.webSearchGeminiModel.description: Model ID for Gemini Google Search grounding. Defaults to gemini-2.5-flash.

providers.antigravityEndpoint.label: Antigravity Endpoint Mode
providers.antigravityEndpoint.description: Endpoint routing strategy for google-antigravity providers (chat, search, image, discovery)

providers.imageOrder.label: Image Provider Order
providers.imageOrder.description: Prioritized providers for image generation; unlisted providers follow the active session provider and the built-in order

providers.fireworksTier.label: Fireworks Tier
providers.fireworksTier.description: Serving path for Fireworks requests. Priority sends `service_tier: "priority"` for higher reliability during peak traffic at a higher price; Standard omits it. Fast (`-fast`) models ignore this — Fast is its own serving path.

live.voice.label: Live Voice
live.voice.description: Voice used by Codex-backed realtime voice sessions

providers.tts.label: Text-to-Speech Provider
providers.tts.description: Backend for the tts tool: local on-device neural TTS (Kokoro-82M), xAI Grok Voice, or DeepInfra speech

tts.localModel.label: Local TTS Model
tts.localModel.description: On-device neural TTS model (Kokoro-82M) used by the local TTS backend

tts.localVoice.label: Local TTS Voice
tts.localVoice.description: Kokoro voice used by the local TTS backend (American/British, female/male)

speech.enabled.label: Speech Vocalization
speech.enabled.description: Speak the assistant's output aloud through the speakers as it streams

speech.mode.label: Speech Vocalization Mode
speech.mode.description: What to speak: all = assistant messages + thinking; assistant = messages only; yield = only the final message at turn end

speech.enhanced.label: Enhanced Speech Rewriting
speech.enhanced.description: Rewrite assistant output into natural spoken prose with the tiny/smol model before synthesis (describes code, drops links and markdown). Falls back to mechanical cleanup on failure

speech.voice.label: Speech Vocalization Voice
speech.voice.description: Kokoro voice used when speaking the assistant's output aloud

providers.tinyModel.label: Tiny Model
providers.tinyModel.description: Session-title model: online (the TINY role from /models, else @smol) by default, or a local on-device model

providers.tinyModelDevice.label: Tiny Model Device
providers.tinyModelDevice.description: Inference backend for local tiny models (titles + memory): an ONNX execution provider, or `mlx` to download MLX weights and run them through mlx-lm on Apple silicon. Default uses CPU-only ONNX. The PI_TINY_DEVICE env var overrides this.

providers.tinyModelDtype.label: Tiny Model Precision
providers.tinyModelDtype.description: ONNX quantization/precision for local tiny models. Default uses each model's shipped dtype (q4); lower precision is faster, higher is more faithful. Ignored by the MLX backend (its repos are pre-quantized 4-bit). The PI_TINY_DTYPE env var overrides this.

providers.memoryModel.label: Memory Model
providers.memoryModel.description: Mnemopi LLM for fact extraction + consolidation: online (the TINY role from /models, else smol/remote) by default, or a local on-device model

providers.autoThinkingModel.label: Auto Thinking Model
providers.autoThinkingModel.description: Difficulty classifier for the `auto` thinking level: online (the TINY role from /models, else smol) by default, or a local on-device model

providers.autoThinkingMaxEffort.label: Auto Thinking Ceiling
providers.autoThinkingMaxEffort.description: Highest effort the `auto` classifier may resolve. `xhigh` keeps the classifier one tier below the top, so only an explicit `ultrathink` reaches `max`; `max` lets a turn the classifier judges exceptional bill the top tier on models that expose it.

features.unexpectedStopDetection.label: Unexpected Stops
features.unexpectedStopDetection.description: Automatically recover when the assistant stops without a visible message. Smart also classifies text-only stops with a small model.

providers.unexpectedStopModel.label: Unexpected Stop Model
providers.unexpectedStopModel.description: Classifier for Smart unexpected-stop detection: online (the TINY role from /models, else smol) by default, or a local on-device model.

providers.kimiApiFormat.label: Kimi API Format
providers.kimiApiFormat.description: API format for Kimi Code provider (auto follows live model metadata)

providers.openaiWebsockets.label: OpenAI WebSockets
providers.openaiWebsockets.description: Websocket policy for OpenAI Codex models (auto uses model defaults, on forces, off disables)

providers.cacheRetention.label: Prompt Cache Retention
providers.cacheRetention.description: Prompt-cache retention forwarded to providers that support it (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenRouter, OpenAI)

providers.streamFirstEventTimeoutSeconds.label: Stream First Event Timeout
providers.streamFirstEventTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the first model stream event; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

providers.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.label: Stream Idle Timeout
providers.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a model stream may stay silent between events; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog

providers.openrouterVariant.label: OpenRouter Routing
providers.openrouterVariant.description: Default routing-variant suffix appended to OpenRouter model IDs (overridden when the selector already names a variant)

providers.fetch.label: Fetch Provider
providers.fetch.description: Reader backend priority for the fetch/read URL tool

codexResets.autoRedeem.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Saved Resets
codexResets.autoRedeem.description: Spend saved Codex rate-limit resets automatically: restore an account blocked by an exhausted 5h or weekly window when a turn is stuck and no other account can take over, and salvage credits that are about to expire. unset asks before the first spend, yes spends without prompting, and no disables both checks.

codexResets.minBlockedMinutes.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Min Block
codexResets.minBlockedMinutes.description: Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted 5h/weekly windows — is at least this many minutes away (don't spend a scarce credit to save a short wait). Raise it (e.g. 360) to ignore 5h-only blocks.

codexResets.keepCredits.label: Codex Auto-Redeem Reserve

commands.dump: Copy session transcript to clipboard (and write LLM request JSON to tmp)
commands.share: Share session via an encrypted link (share server or secret gist)
commands.collab: Share this session live via a relay
commands.browser: Toggle browser eval-prelude headless vs visible mode
commands.copy: Pick text or code from the conversation to copy
commands.open: Open the last link from the conversation in your browser (or pick one with /copy)
commands.todo: View or modify the agent's todo list
commands.tools: Show tools currently visible to the agent
commands.agents: Open the agents hub (per-agent model, prewalk, and advisor)
commands.git: Open the git UI (split diff viewer, staging, commit composer)
commands.branch: Rewind to a previous message, keeping the old path as a branch
commands.fork: Create a new fork from a previous message
commands.mcp: Manage MCP servers (add, list, remove, test)
commands.fresh: Reset provider stream state without changing the local transcript
commands.clear: Clear the conversation context in place, keeping the session
commands.drop: Delete the current session and start a new one
commands.shake: Drop heavy content from context (tool results, large blocks)
commands.handoff: Hand off session context to a new session
commands.pin: Pin or unpin a session at the top of the resume list
commands.btw: Ask an ephemeral side question using the current session context
commands.tan: Run a full background agent on tangential work
commands.omfg: Forge a TTSR rule from a complaint to stop a recurring behavior
commands.cleanse: Detect and fix project diagnostics with weighted parallel subagents
commands.retry: Retry the last failed agent turn
commands.move: Move the current session to a different directory
commands.wt: Move this session into a new worktree, changes included
commands.add-dir: Add a workspace directory to this session (multi-root)
commands.remove-dir: Remove a workspace directory from this session
commands.restart: Restart omp with the same launch flags, resuming this session
commands.marketplace: Manage marketplace plugin sources and installed plugins
commands.reload-plugins: Reload all plugins (skills, commands, hooks, tools, agents, MCP)
commands.force: Force next turn to use a specific tool
commands.pause: Freeze all agents (main, subagents, advisor) until resumed

security.plan: Create an immutable security scan plan
security.scan: Start a planned or newly planned native scan
security.show: Render a scan or security:// resource
security.import: Import SARIF or a Codex Security bundle
security.export: Export a canonical bundle, SARIF, or report
security.validate: Validate one finding with OMP-native tools
security.compare: Compare finding lineage across two scans
security.disposition: Set a finding disposition with rationale

setup.providers: Configure sign-in and web search providers

skillful.on: List skills in the prompt for this session
skillful.off: Omit the skills listing for this session

computer.on: Enable computer use for this session
computer.off: Disable computer use for this session

advisor.dump: Copy the advisor's transcript to clipboard

collab.view: Share a read-only link (guests can watch, not prompt)

todo.copy: Copy todos as Markdown to clipboard
todo.expand: Show every phase and task in the HUD
todo.export: Write todos as Markdown to a file (default: TODO.md)
todo.import: Replace todos from a Markdown file (default: TODO.md)
todo.append: Append a task; phase fuzzy-matched or auto-created

session.delete: Delete current session and return to selector
session.pin: Pin the current provider to a stored OAuth account

usage.reset: Spend a saved Codex rate-limit reset

mcp.unauth: Remove OAuth auth from a server
mcp.smithery-search: Search Smithery registry and deploy an MCP server
mcp.smithery-login: Login to Smithery and cache API key
mcp.reconnect: Reconnect to a specific MCP server
mcp.resources: List available resources from connected servers
mcp.prompts: List available prompts from connected servers

compact.soft: Summarize locally with the active model (skip server compaction)
compact.remote: Summarize via OpenAI-compatible server compaction, then fall back to a local summary
compact.snapcompact: Archive history onto dense bitmap images the model reads back (no LLM call)

memory.queue: Show pending memory deltas awaiting consolidation
memory.clear: Clear persisted memory data and artifacts
memory.mm list: List mental models on the active bank
memory.mm refresh: Refresh auto-refresh models bank-wide, or one model by id
memory.mm history: Diff the change history of a mental model
memory.mm seed: Create any built-in mental models that are missing
memory.mm delete: Delete a mental model from the bank (id required)

marketplace.install: Install a plugin (interactive browser if no args)
marketplace.uninstall: Uninstall a plugin (selector if no args)
